data.action: 在玄关凳上系齐半扎发缎带，俏皮歪头检查。
data.description: 周末出门前，有希穿淡黄针织背心和藏蓝长裙，坐在玄关凳上重新系好半扎发的缎带。她咬着嘴角认真拉齐两边，完成后朝门旁的光线俏皮地一歪头，端庄与活泼只隔一个动作。
data.promptProse: Before a weekend outing, Yuki sits on the entryway bench in a butter-yellow knit vest over a white puff-sleeve blouse and navy calf-length skirt. She carefully evens the ribbon securing her half-up hair, then tips her head playfully toward the doorway light. The medium environmental view includes the bench beneath her and the entry floor beyond. Soft daylight brightens her ribbon and vest stitches, shading the skirt folds.
data.title: 周防有希 · 周末玄关的发带结
